GUIDE / 08

Configuration reference

Use CLI flags directly or a YAML launch file. Both reach the same implementation. YAML paths resolve relative to the configuration file.

The public input is LearningMaterial. Use --learning-material DIR or YAML learning_material: DIR. The old --evidence and evidence names remain aliases; do not supply both names. Paths in YAML resolve relative to the configuration file.

Evolution YAML

action: evolve
architecture: prompt-only
learning_material: ../examples/mwm_evidence
backend: codex
prompt: Read the LearningMaterial and improve ADAPTER.md.
network: false
read_access:
  paths: []

Use adapter instead of architecture to continue an existing candidate. Use prompt_file instead of prompt for a Markdown instruction file. An optional validation field points to a separate validation directory. --template and the YAML template key remain compatibility aliases for architecture.

harnessadapter run config/evolve.yaml --dry-run
harnessadapter run config/evolve.yaml --prepare-only
harnessadapter run config/evolve.yaml

Deployment YAML

action: deploy
adapter: prompt-only
host: codex
workdir: ../.demo/prompt-only/codex

Evolution flags

FlagMeaning
--architecture NAMEInitialize a separate candidate from prompt-only, mwm, or a directory
positional adapterContinue from an existing adapter directory
--learning-material DIRRequired read-only storage with README.md
--validation DIROptional visible read-only validation storage
--prompt TEXT / --prompt-file FILEUser update instructions
--evolver NAMEReusable basic, mwm, animation-coach, or physics-builder preset, or local definition directory
--model IDExplicit learner model
--reasoning-effort LEVELCodex effort: low, medium, high, xhigh
--backendcodex or claude-code
--workdir DIRRead-only environment cwd for learner commands
--read-dir DIR / --read-allAdditional reads; never grants writes
--network / --no-networkAgent tool networking; default on
--config FILEExecution policy in TOML, JSON, or YAML
--timeout SECONDSModel session timeout; default 240
--max-budget-usd NClaude-only model budget; rejected for Codex
--prepare-onlyPrepare candidate and run permission preflight, no learner model call

Launch YAML uses backend for the learner and host for the acting agent. Unknown fields fail validation. A list of multiple adapters is explicitly rejected until multi-adapter deployment exists.

Training State protocol

Training State is an optional input/output for a stateful Evolver, separate from the Adapter and reusable algorithm definition. No generic training-state CLI or YAML field is implemented yet; do not treat run logs as resumable optimizer state. Stateless methods require no state artifact.
